neighbours.label: a split lead piece whose continuation is forced: ' don'/' wasn'/' isn' before 't, the bare space before a number's digits, 'in' before 'mind', as against the same sentences with uncontracted negation and numbers in words
fire: Please tell her I don't need a lift tomorrow.
The bakery wasn't open when we walked past.
My grandfather was born in 1931 in a small village.
We paid 2750 euros for the second-hand car.
Honestly, the film isn't as long as people say.
The bridge was finished in 1897 after many delays.
Their team couldn't score in the second half.
Please keep in mind that the museum closes early on Sundays.
quiet: Please tell her I do not need a lift tomorrow.
The bakery was closed when we walked past.
My grandfather was born before the war in a small village.
We paid a few thousand euros for the second-hand car.
Honestly, the film is not as long as people say.
The bridge was finished last century after many delays.
Their team could not score in the second half.
Please remember that the museum closes early on Sundays.

predictions: fire 0.6-0.9; uncontracted/wordy near misses lower, perhaps 0.2-0.5
short: lead piece of a forced continuation
